decision: In-game prop: a small sci-fi cargo box for Snow Fortress, generated by TRELLIS.2 (same generator as the helicopter, walls and container). Closed object with depth (relief 0.60), seen from any angle, so a mesh prop. Built by scene_kit at 6 studs long (3.8 tall, 4.1 wide), bottom pivot, decimated to 9,000 triangles in one mesh; the tile advice is overridden as for the other props (compact object). At this size 9k triangles is generous and the rounded body, lid and panel blocks hold. Textures converted from 2048 WebP to 1024 PNG. Unlike the container, the base colour was NOT baked dark (mean ~119, grey/white/orange), so no tint or gamma. It is mostly grey and white rather than orange, and white panels could wash out on snow; judge in game. Intended as waist-high cover, so if made collidable it is a deliberate prop exception the layout gates cannot audit.
